block_row: Structural top of the USB 2.0 controller.

frame_row: Structural top of the USB 2.0 controller. It instantiates the blocks below and holds no logic of its own. The four wrappers add the fixed port profile of the PHY and data interfaces.

label: u_phyif
(m_usb2_phyif_*)
blocks.function: PHY interface. Adapts the UTMI+ or ULPI pins of the PHY to one internal byte stream and mode control.

label: u_lnk
(m_usb2_lnk)
blocks.function: USB link. Assembles and disassembles packets, checks PID and CRC, and times the bus turn-around.

label: u_dev
(m_usb2_dev)
blocks.function: Device engine. Matches address and endpoint, keeps the data toggle and chooses the handshake.

label: u_fifo
(m_usb2_fifo)
blocks.function: FIFO manager. Owns the shared RAM, divides it into regions and arbitrates the packet and bus ports.

label: u_spd
(m_usb2_spd)
blocks.function: Speed and power controller. Runs reset, chirp, suspend, resume, link power management, test modes and the role choice.

label: u_host
(m_usb2_host)
blocks.function: Host engine. Schedules channels, sends frame markers and runs the host transactions and split phases.

label: u_cdc
(m_usb2_cdc_*)
blocks.function: Clock crossing. Moves levels, event pulses and the FIFO bus port between the two clock domains.

label: u_rst
(m_usb2_rst)
blocks.function: Reset controller. Synchronizes the release of both resets and runs the soft-reset sequence.

label: u_csr
(m_vlsit_csr_usb2)
blocks.function: Register block. Generated bus-accessible control and status registers.

label: u_irq
(m_usb2_irq)
blocks.function: Interrupt block. Collects event flags and drives the interrupt output.

label: u_dma
(m_usb2_dma)
blocks.function: Data mover. Moves payload between memory and the FIFO regions, or serves window accesses and DMA requests.
